claims.statement: The Agent Host is an Electron utilityProcess entrypoint (src/agent-host/index.ts) that runs pi-coding-agent in-process, registers all API handlers, and serves requests/streams over MessagePort via a single RPC server.

HostManager (src/main/host-manager.ts) supervises the Agent Host: on 'ready' it redelivers toolchain and browser snapshots, pushes managed-process owner identity, starts the 15s ping loop, and kills the child if a pong is absent for 10s.

The Host restart budget allows at most MAX_RESTARTS (2) restarts within a rolling CRASH_WINDOW_MS (30s); exceeding the budget sets the Host status to 'crashed' (reserveHostRestart in src/main/host-restart-core.ts).
On child exit, HostManager only schedules a restart after the beforeRestartHandler (managed-process cleanup) runs without error; an unresolved cleanup flips the Host to 'crashed'.

src/contract/rpc.ts implements a dependency-free MessagePort RPC with five wire message kinds (request/response/subscribe/unsubscribe/event); the client enforces a default 120s call timeout and the server tracks per-port subscriptions and leases.
The RPC server attaches a port via ensureSubs and forgetPort, and on remote port close (ISSUE-013) it drops the port and finalizes its leases and subscription state.
HostMessagePort to the renderer is transferred via window.postMessage from the preload (src/preload/preload.ts, src/renderer/lib/api-client.ts), never through contextBridge as a Promise value.

The renderer RPC facade (src/renderer/lib/api-client.ts) waits for Host ready status, requests the transferred port, validates with host.ping, and on crash resets the client so a fresh port is requested after the Host restarts.
The Agent Host handles uncaughtException/unhandledRejection by logging and calling process.exit(1) on the next tick, leaving restart to the main-process supervisor.

src/contract/api.ts defines the full request/response Api and server-push Streams surface, including agent.new/agent.command, sessions.*, auth.*, skills/plugins, channels.*, processes.*, files/worktrees, and models.*.
